claim: Château de La Rochepot remains closed to the public in 2026; the property was officially confiscated from former owner Dmitri Malinovsky on 12 March 2026 and AGRASC is running emergency restoration works while awaiting resale.
quote: Le château de La Rochepot officiellement confisqué à son ancien propriétaire ukrainien... La cour d'appel de Metz a officiellement prononcé la confiscation du château.

claim: The local Nolay tourist office confirms Château de La Rochepot is closed to the public and can only be photographed from the outside.
quote: The château is closed to the public – it can only be to photographed from the outside.

claim: Château de Couches (the 'Marguerite de Bourgogne' fortress, ~15 km west of Chagny) runs guided visits with an €8 flat-rate audio guide and major 2026 events including Journées du Patrimoine (19-20 Sept), Halloween (21 Oct-1 Nov) and Noël au Château (19-30 Dec).
quote: Les journées du patrimoine... Halloween... Noël au Château... audio guide... 8€

claim: Château de Rully (≈5 km from Chagny) is a privately owned medieval château offering guided interior tours of ground and first floors with a tasting of three local wines paired with gougères in either the medieval kitchen or 15th-century cellar.
quote: discover and taste our wines... a famous wine Estate especially for its Chardonnay wines

claim: Château de Rully welcomes guests year-round; adult admission is €10 (free under 12), credit cards are not accepted, and in July-August visits are by appointment only, otherwise daily 10:45-18:00 in high season.
quote: Adults €10. Free for children under 12. Credit cards are not accepted... visits by appointment only in July and August.

claim: Château de Pommard (≈20 km north of Chagny) offers three booked tastings in 2026: Discover Burgundy €30/adult (4 cuvées, 1h), Clos Marey-Monge €41/adult, and Custom Tasting €94/adult (6 wines, private); reservation recommended.
quote: Discover Burgundy - €30/adult... Clos Marey Monge Tasting - €41/adult... Custom Tasting - €94/adult... 15 rue Marey Monge, 21630 Pommard

claim: Château du Clos de Vougeot, headquarters of the Confrérie des Chevaliers du Tastevin, is open daily in 2026: low season (Nov-Mar) 10:00-17:00, high season (Apr-Oct) 09:30-18:00; guided tour €15, self-guided free during opening hours, sensory experience €45.
quote: Low season (Nov 1 - Mar 31): 10h-17h. High season (Apr 1 - Oct 31): 9h30-18h. Guided tour: €15... Sensory experience: €45

claim: The Château du Clos de Vougeot sits in the village of Vougeot in the Côte de Nuits, about 25 km from Dijon — roughly 55-60 km north-east of Chagny by road, well BEYOND the 30 km radius.
quote: Clos de Vougeot is an Appellation d'origine contrôlée (AOC) for red wine in Burgundy... located in the village of Vougeot... Côte de Nuits

claim: Abbaye de Cîteaux is open 22 Apr–5 Jul and 29 Sep–1 Nov 2026, Wed-Sun 10:00-13:00 / 14:00-18:00; guided tours last 1h15 and reservations are essential, with a ten-minute walk from the parking to reception — but the abbey lies ~30 km from Beaune (so ~45-50 km from Chagny), beyond the 30 km radius.
quote: Tours are 1¼ hours and reservations are essential. There is about a ten-minute walk from the parking lot to the visitor reception.

claim: Château de Sully (in Sully, Saône-et-Loire — birthplace of Maréchal de MacMahon, not Vauban) is open daily 4 Apr–1 Nov 2026, 09:30-17:00; admission with guided tour of château plus park is €10.20 adults, €4.50 children, €29 family rate.
quote: open every day, including public holidays, from 04/04/2026 to 01/11/2026, from 9:30am to 5pm... Adults €10.20, Children €4.50, Large families €29

claim: The Hospices de Beaune / Hôtel-Dieu charges €12.50 full-price adult, €6.25 ages 6-17, €9.50 reduced (students under 26, large families, jobseekers), free under 6; open 09:00-19:30 continuous from 1 Apr to 15 Nov 2026, otherwise 09:00-12:30 and 14:00-18:30.
quote: Full price adult ticket: €12.50... Reduced price: €6.25... €9.50... open continuously from 9AM to 7:30PM

claim: Chagny's Tour Bajole is a 12th-century building once linked to the priory of Saint-Georges; it currently houses Maison Lameloise itself and is visible only from outside.
quote: As early as the 12th century, this building was dependent on the powerful priory of Saint George... Currently, it houses a gastronomic restaurant, and it is only visible from the outside.

claim: A guided 'Discovering Chagny' walking tour runs June-September on Tuesdays at 15:00, covering the 12th-13th-century Saint-Martin church and Romanesque bell tower, the 1715 hospital apothecary, and the 15th/18th-century towers.
quote: A guided tour 'Discovering Chagny' is available from June to September, Tuesdays at 3 p.m... Saint Martin church and its Romanesque bell tower... apothecary from 1715

claim: Beaune's Collégiale Notre-Dame is open daily 08:00-18:00 with free entry; its 15th-century Tournai tapestries of the Life of the Virgin are viewable April-October on Wed/Thu/Fri/Sun 14:30-17:30 and Sat 10:00-12:00 for a €3 guided fee.
quote: the tapestries are accessible by a €3 guided tour between April and mid-November... Wednesday-Thursday-Friday and Sunday: 2.30pm-5.30pm / Saturday 10am-12pm
